title: They Stain Clothes
text: They Stain Clothes. It smelled great, then I noticed it was like saw dust. When I took the sachet away out of my hand there was red dust.  I mostly use the cedar sachets, the cedar hangers, balls and squares for my better sweaters — cashmere, merino wool, hand-made items, etc., So I definitely, don’t want to stain them with red cedar powder. I prefer the ones with Cedar Chips. The scent is the same but seems safer for my good garments.
